title: Report of one keel planning reviewer
description: ticket-reviewer and plan-reviewer return exactly one JSON object of this shape. A finding points at a draft ticket or a part of the plan, not at code; the user decides on each one (decision).

status.description: 'incomplete' when the agent hit its turn cap.

note.description: With status 'incomplete': what is left (the tickets or checks not done).

checks.description: One answer per checklist item: per reviewed ticket for ticket-reviewer, for the plan for plan-reviewer.

findings.description: Up to 5 per ticket (4 tickets per call), up to 10 for the plan.

place.description: A draft ticket (T3), a section of plan.md, or the plan as a whole.
place.pattern: ^(T[1-9][0-9]*|plan|Summary|Problem / Goal|Decisions|Out of scope|Design sketch|Terms|Open questions|Tickets|Next action)$

check.description: Ticket checklist, then plan checklist. 'yes' is good.
The checklist item it fails, or 'other' for what the checklist does not cover.

severity.description: critical: a developer would build the wrong thing or cannot start; important: gets stuck or must guess; minor: wording.

problem.description: Why it is a problem for the developer who picks the ticket up.

fix.description: The smallest change to the ticket or plan text.

evidence.description: The words of the ticket or plan that show it, and what the code shows.

code.description: file:line of the code the claim rests on, relative to the project root.

decision.description: The user's decision on one finding, as the conversation records it in reviews/<ticket>.md; the next review gets these as already decided.

choice.description: fix it now, defer it to an open question, or reject it.

reason.description: What was changed, which question holds it, or why it is rejected.
